_comment: Action-kind defaults (see docs/design/ACTIONS.md). Each encounter in observations.json names a `kind` and inherits its default actions; a spot may add/remove/replace via its own `actions` block. An action: id, label, optional unlock_when (when it's OFFERED), result_text (the deed's own voice, surfaced on take), set_flag (world-state it changes -> the ambient engine re-checks -> a missed thought can come back), one_shot (leaves the menu once taken). Start small: inanimate, water, clearing, remains.

actions.label: Search around it
actions.result_text: You crouch and feel through the grass at its base. Grit, old roots, nothing more.

actions.label: Rest a hand on it
actions.result_text: Cold under your palm. It has been cold a long time.

actions.label: Follow the channel
actions.result_text: You trace where the water ran, until the ground swallows the trail.

actions.label: Sit a while
actions.result_text: You sit. The quiet settles over you like a coat.

actions.label: Sit with it
actions.result_text: You stay beside the old stones until the light shifts.
